LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_ReproductionLust.label: (Raven) Reproduction Lust
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_ReproductionLust.descriptio: Driven by culture and instinct, this pawn is fanatically obsessed with reproduction. As the number of lovin' sessions increases, this lust does not subside, but instead, it transforms into greater vitality, social charisma, and assassination instinct.
